Bill Alarm

Never miss a due date again.

Bill Alarm puts all your bills in one place and keeps reminding you until each is due. No account or sign-up is needed, and your data stays on your iPhone.

Download on theApp StoreVisit the Bill Alarm website (opens in a new tab)
Category
Finance
Platforms
iPhone

What Bill Alarm does

  • All bills in one place

    The total due over the next 60 days and a timeline of every due date.

  • Next bill first

    Total and minimum amount for the next bill, with one-tap pay or mark as paid.

  • Repeating reminders

    Alerts at 9 AM and 6 PM daily, starting 8 days before the due date.

  • Quick bill entry

    Pick a bill type, enter the amount and date, and set regular bills to repeat monthly.

  • Stays on your phone

    Nothing is sent to servers, and cards only ask for the last 4 digits.
